name: Thermo Lab
desc: A heat-equation lab: thermal diffusivity and boundary-condition sliders drive the 1D diffusion of temperature, with energy conservation and steady-state readouts.
controls: Diffusivity and boundary-condition sliders, four initial-condition presets (hot spot/gradient/sine/step), run/pause and reset buttons; keys 1–4 load presets, Space runs/pauses, R resets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
